title: Confirmar um Atraso no Transporte
wrap_friend: 你剛剛完成了一段 A2 交通服務情境，確認重點並做出簡單回應。
learner_goal: Understand a delay duration and choose whether to wait or take another route.
register_notes: Brazilian Portuguese public transport/service language with polite everyday responses; no refund, legal, medical, police, or identity-sensitive handling.
support_text: Pergunte ao funcionário da estação sobre um atraso, confirme a duração e escolha um próximo passo simples.

notes.authoring_policy: Fresh-authored from the neutral A2 transport brief. KO surfaces were used only as scenario blueprint, not as translation source.
notes.a2_boundary: Low-risk A2 transport/service task; avoids refund, compensation, emergency, identity-sensitive, legal, medical, banking, immigration, or police handling.
notes.language_specific_adaptation: NPC lines, learner targets, distractors, feedback, support text, and translations are adapted for this language; native review remains pending.
notes.scenario_realism_repair_20260615: Reframed from a broadcast-to-dialogue hybrid into a station-staff information request flow: staff states the delay, learner confirms it, staff offers wait/bus options, and the bus option may end the dialogue.
